subject: Social Science
description: A simple social science lesson about people and places around us.

lines.text: A neighbourhood is the area where people live together.
lines.explanation: Neighbourhood woh jagah hai jahan log saath rehte hain.

lines.text: It can have houses, shops, schools, and parks.
lines.explanation: Yahan ghar, dukaan, school aur park ho sakte hain.

lines.text: People in a neighbourhood should help and respect one another.
lines.explanation: Sabko ek dusre ki help aur respect karni chahiye.

lines.hint: Tell the meaning in one short sentence.

lines.text: Clean streets and kind neighbours make life better.
lines.explanation: Saaf streets aur achhe neighbours life ko better banate hain.
